name: Erythromycin Propionate

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Mauritius and 2 other countries, first in 1982 — for liver harm

summary: Erythromycin Propionate was removed from the market in Mauritius and two other countries, starting in 1982, due to concerns about liver harm [3]. In addition, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated potential risks, giving the drug a high score of 84 for liver problems [M]. That same computer model assigned it a low score of 17 for heart issues [M].
